text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Arima Kinen is finally here. Hoping to make it a perfect finale, Fine Motion swears to put on a performance that will remain in the hearts of everyone who watches.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fine Motion's close friend Daiwa Scarlet is running today. And that's not all…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Air Shakur is running too. Fine Motion feels that she would make for the perfect opponent in her final race, given that Shakur was there when she started running.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: At long last, the starting signal is primed for their final battle.
